camel_example: aliyun ndr UpdateDeliveryDestination --region cn-hangzhou --Sites.1.Site global --Sites.1.SpaceQuota 1099511627776 --Sites.1.Region 'cn-hangzhou' --Sites.1.TTL 30 --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Updates an enabled log delivery destination of the new version, including the target site set, region, storage quota, and log retention days. Sites must contain the complete set of sites after the update. If the configuration is unchanged and no recovery is required, no task is submitted. If only the retention days are adjusted for a single site, the change is processed synchronously. Other changes are submitted as asynchronous tasks and a TaskId is returned. Call DescribeDeliveryDestination to query the latest task status and configuration
description_zh: 更新已开通的新版日志存储目的地，包括目标站点集合、地域、存储配额和日志保存天数。Sites 应包含本次更新后的完整站点集合。配置无变化且无需恢复时不提交任务；单站点仅调整保存天数时同步处理，其余变更提交异步任务并返回 TaskId。可通过 DescribeDeliveryDestination 查询最新任务状态与配置
name: UpdateDeliveryDestination

fields.help_en: The region ID of the Simple Log Service destination. If this parameter is not specified, the existing region of the site is retained. For a new site, the default region of the site is used. The final regions used by different sites cannot be the same
fields.help_zh: 日志服务目的地的地域 ID。不传时保留该站点已有地域；新站点使用站点默认地域。不同站点最终使用的地域不能相同
fields.name: region

fields.help_en: The target site identifier. global indicates unified delivery to a single site. cn indicates Alibaba Cloud China Website. intl indicates Alibaba Cloud International Website. gov indicates Alibaba Gov Cloud
fields.help_zh: 目标站点标识。global 表示单站点统一投递；cn 表示中国站，intl 表示国际站，gov 表示政务云站点
fields.name: site

fields.help_en: The storage quota of the site, in bytes. The value must be a positive integer multiple of 1099511627776 bytes (1 TiB) or 1073741824000 bytes (1000 GiB). The sum of quotas across all sites cannot exceed the total purchased quota. For a single-site destination, if this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the total purchased quota is automatically used. When updating a single site that remains in single-site mode, the quota must equal the total purchased quota. In a multi-site update, the quota of an existing site whose region remains unchanged cannot be lower than the used amount
fields.help_zh: 该站点的存储配额，单位为字节。须为 1099511627776 字节（1 TiB）或 1073741824000 字节（1000 GiB）的正整数倍；各站点配额之和不能超过已购买总配额。目标为单站点时，不传或传 0 自动使用已购买总配额；单站点保持单站点的更新，其配额须等于已购买总配额。多站点更新中，地域不变的已有站点配额不能低于已使用量
fields.name: space_quota

fields.help_en: The number of days to retain logs for the site. This parameter is required. Valid values: 7 to 730
fields.help_zh: 该站点日志的保存天数，必须传入，取值为 7～730
fields.name: ttl

parameters.help_en: The complete list of target site configurations after the update. This parameter cannot be empty. In single-site mode, pass only global. In multi-site mode, pass sites from cn, intl, and gov. The list cannot contain global in multi-site mode. Each site must include Site and TTL. Switching between single-site and multi-site modes is subject to the remaining number of switches allowed in the current month
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的完整目标站点配置列表，不能为空。单站点模式只传 global；多站点模式传 cn、intl、gov 中的站点，不能包含 global。每个站点须传入 Site 和 TTL。单站点与多站点之间的切换受本月剩余切换次数限制
parameters.name: sites

Data.description_en: The update result of the delivery destination

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task submitted in this request. This field is not returned if the configuration is unchanged and no recovery is required, or if only the retention days are adjusted for a single site and the change is processed synchronously. The absence of a TaskId does not indicate a request failure
TaskId.description_zh: 本次提交的异步任务 ID。配置未变化且无需恢复，或单站点仅调整保存天数并同步完成时，不返回本字段；无 TaskId 不表示请求失败

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a failure scenario
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示失败场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. When the request fails, this parameter describes the error cause. The example shows a parameter validation failure scenario
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示参数校验失败场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
